upstream.description: All-in-One Sandbox for AI Agents that combines Browser, Shell, File, MCP and VSCode Server in a single Docker container.

classification.analysis: AIO Sandbox is an all-in-one Docker container that bundles a browser (VNC + CDP), shell terminal, file system, VSCode Server, Jupyter notebook, and MCP servers into a single agent execution environment with a shared filesystem across all components. It exposes a REST API plus Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs so AI agent frameworks (browser-use, LangChain, LangGraph deepagents, ag2) can spin up an isolated sandbox for code execution, browser automation, and file manipulation in one place. It targets AI agent developers who need a secure, unified sandbox rather than stitching together separate single-purpose containers, and includes an evaluation harness for benchmarking agent performance inside the sandbox. Backed by a published paper and active releases on PyPI/npm/GHCR.

use_cases.title: Run an AI agent's browser automation and shell commands in one isolated container
Give a LangGraph or browser-use agent a shared filesystem across browser, shell, and file tools
Self-host a secure code-execution backend for an AI coding assistant
Benchmark agent task performance using the included evaluation dataset
